long_description_md:
## What it does

`aeon-skill-pack-vvvkernel` is a community skill pack for [Aeon](https://github.com/aaronjmars/aeon) that calls [VVVKernel](https://vvvkernel.com) — a gateway to Venice AI experts running private inference, paid via USDC/x402 on Base (or covered by staked VVV token tiers).

It ships nine skills spanning on-demand routing and scheduled reports:

- **vvvkernel** — generic router to any Venice AI expert (onchain, audit, growth, brand, narrative, community, tier-design).
- **vvvkernel-brief** — daily morning brief combining onchain intel, growth pulse, and a narrative action item.
- **vvvkernel-onchain** — daily Base onchain intelligence report.
- **vvvkernel-audit** — AI-assisted smart-contract pre-review (explicitly NOT a substitute for a professional audit).
- **vvvkernel-narrative** — generate tweets, threads, and announcements.
- **vvvkernel-growth** — weekly growth analysis with metrics, sentiment, and recommendations.
- **vvvkernel-image** — image generation via Venice AI Flux.1.
- **vvvkernel-monitor** — continuous (every 4h) onchain anomaly detection on holders, liquidity, and smart-money flow.
- **vvvkernel-digest** — weekly digest rolling up all other skill outputs into one prioritized summary.

Every skill checks account balance before running and exits cleanly if VVVKernel is unreachable or the balance is empty.

## Setup

Requires a VVVKernel account with USDC on Base or staked VVV token, plus a `VVVKERNEL_JWT` secret in your Aeon repo. See the repo README for wallet and tier details.

## Notes

The pack README states it is a community skill pack and not part of the official Aeon catalog. The repository ships no LICENSE file (license is unspecified in-repo, though the upstream Aeon registry lists it as MIT).
